test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rishabh starts from his house and walks 14 m southwards. Then, he turns left and walks 30 m. Then, he turns left and walks 50 m. Then, he turns left and walks 10 m. He then turns left and walks 36 m. In which direction and how many meters away is he now from his house?
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: Rishabh starts from his house and walks 14 m southwards. Then, he turns left and walks 30 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee3f6e2529e959983fa7d529965cd82eb0cd374355c982eddff388f33db2ba92.png] 

Step 2: Then, he turns left and walks 50 m. Then, he turns left and walks 10 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a0b6b3698b51a0912e7e29de7ff61f2d232db7a7683aaf49e8da8b1191c3810.png] 

Step 3: He then turns left and walks 36 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e3a23f40fe389073cf8aac35d92d032ef5c17186f9bde80fd9eabbe4574517e.png] 

Distance from house to end point = 30m - 10m = 20m

From the diagram we can see that **Rishabh is 20m away from his home towards east.**

Hence the correct answer is **option 4)**
